items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: So we always had four saxophones. At times we had three flutes because Shihab played flute, Jerome played flute, and Les Spann, you know. But it was such a good band.

ctx.x: He plays on radio in Geneva. And a trumpet player out of Seattle, he doubled on saxophone. So we always had four saxophones. At times we had three flutes because Shihab played flute, Jerome played flute, and Les Spann, you know. But it was such a good band. You know, we memorized the show?
Just two trombones? You and Melba Liston?
